evidence.quote: In this connection, the SFC wishes to remind licensed corporations (LCs) to assess the impact of the Transition on their businesses and take appropriate measures to maintain their smooth and effective operations after the Transition.

findings.title_or_locator: SFC circular, refNo=24EC16 (official locator in source packet)

details: The supplied text does not specify the complete instrument coverage or instrument-specific exceptions.
This definition broadens Transition-based provisions; it does not expressly replace references specifically limited to US securities.
The reminder uses no express must; SHOULD reflects its connection to the express readiness recommendation.
The reminder does not expressly use must.
The grammatical reach of 'where appropriate' across all listed enhancements versus staffing arrangements specifically is not explicit.
The packet does not establish whether any particular LC also acts as such a management company.

findings.details: No express exemption or prohibition from LC readiness expectations is supplied. Optional staffing measures and appropriateness qualifications should not be converted into mandatory methods.
The general reminders use no express must. The detailed LC readiness provisions use should, including the items introduced by 'including'.

The Canadian footnote extends references to the Transition throughout the circular, but the text leaves the relationship between that extension and expressly US-specific funding and cross-currency wording unstated.
No external incorporated authority is identified in the supplied text; the three numbered references are supplied explanatory footnotes.
The effective dates describe market settlement changes; no separate calendar deadline for completing LC assessments, training or client communications is expressly stated.
